This vignette reproduces the original multimodel Q chart experiment with the
package API. The default chunks are not evaluated during package builds because
the full Monte Carlo experiment is intentionally expensive.

```{r experiment}
library(fromage)
library(dplyr)

lags <- c(1, 5, 15, 25, 50, 99)

h0 <- c(0.4, 0.3)
h1 <- c(0.6, 0.5)
h2 <- c(0.8, 0.7)
h3 <- c(0.2, 0.1)
h4 <- c(-0.4, -0.3)

names(h0) <- names(h1) <- names(h2) <- names(h3) <- names(h4) <- c("ar1", "ma1")

modelo_h0 <- h0
modelos_h1 <- list(h0, h1, h2, h3, h4)

set.seed(2026)
teste1 <- online_power_table_mm(
  lags = lags,
  h0_model = modelo_h0,
  h1_models = modelos_h1,
  n = 100,
  n_mc = 1000,
  n_boot = 500,
  cores = 16
)
```

```{r plot-data}
h1_labels <- c(
  "ARMA(0.4,0.3)",
  "ARMA(0.6,0.5)",
  "ARMA(0.8,0.7)",
  "ARMA(0.2,0.1)",
  "ARMA(-0.4,-0.3)"
)

df_q <- cria_df_poder(
  resultados = teste1,
  lags = lags,
  h1_labels = h1_labels,
  tipo_teste = "Q Multi-Modelo"
)

df_res <- cria_df_poder(
  resultados = teste1,
  lags = lags,
  h1_labels = h1_labels,
  tipo_teste = "Resíduo Auto-Arima"
)

df_plot <- bind_rows(df_q, df_res)
```

```{r plot}
info_experimento <- paste(
  "Modelo Fase 1 = ARMA(0.4,0.3)",
  "Ordem = (1,0,1)",
  "MC = 1000",
  "Boot = 500",
  "Alpha = 0.05",
  "Lag Q = 10",
  "Lags = {1, 5, 15, 25, 50, 99}",
  "Modelos Candidatos Q: ARMA(max.p=2,max.q=2)",
  "SD = 1",
  "Seed = 2026",
  sep = " | "
)

plot_power_curve(
  df_plot = df_plot,
  info_experimento = info_experimento,
  h1_labels = h1_labels
)
```
